relationships.subject: SCN9A I1739V mutation
relationships.evidence_quote: Electrophysiological voltage clamp studies of this mutation show a gain of function with an increased hyperexcitability and a reduced current threshold with increased firing frequency when responding to depolarizing stimuli [5].

key_findings: A father and daughter with identical SCN9A I739V genotype showed different phenotypes (reduced sensitivity vs small fiber neuropathy), implying genetic modifiers.
The I739V variant was found in about 1% of 400 neuropathy patients with little difference in pain frequency.
